name: codedp-bench-mia-function
description: A benchmark that evaluates membership inference vulnerability at the function level for code models: given a function or model outputs, the task is to predict whether that function was part of a model's training data. It measures model privacy leakage and robustness to membership inference attacks on code data. Results inform defenses and privacy-preserving training strategies for code models.
reputation: A niche dataset used primarily by privacy and security researchers studying membership inference on code; limited widespread adoption.
